en: Black‑and‑white seaside view showing a sandy beach with dunes, a long wooden pier stretching into the water, and wooded hills in the background. On the right stand ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century resort villas among trees. In the foreground a man with a walking stick and a woman in long skirt and hat stroll along a sandy path. A signpost stands near the dunes with German text on it.
